<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex21022025-01-0814-32-313" status="finalized">
         <milestone unit="section" n="Introductory verses (1b1-2)"/>
        <lg><l>rgyal sras myu gu byang chub sems ||</l>
         <l>gzhan don spyod pas legs bsrungs pa'i ||</l>
         <l>'bras bu rdzogs pa rang gzhan don ||</l>
        <l><lb n="1b2"/> lhun grub sku la gus pas 'dud ||</l></lg>
        <lg><l><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4625">mdo sde kun las btus pa'i don</rs> ||</l> 
        <l><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4625">gsal byed nyi ma'i snying po</rs> 'di ||</l> 
       <l><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3876"><expan>ye shes</expan></rs> dang ni <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3839">brtson 'grus</rs> kyi ||</l> 
       <l>mying ×can gsung bzhin legs bshad brtsam ||</l></lg>
       </seg></TEI>
